  • Constructor Details

    • SettingsModel

      public SettingsModel(boolean communityParticipation, boolean activityDataParticipation, boolean checkinDataParticipation, boolean AIPersonalise, boolean AIActivityPersonalise, boolean AICheckinPersonalise)
      Constructs a new Settings with the chosen values for the setting's pages.
      Parameters:
      communityParticipation - : Boolean which allows the user to be included in the community statistics.
      activityDataParticipation - : Boolean which allows the user to be included in the community activity statistics.
      checkinDataParticipation - : Boolean which allows the user to be included in the community checkin statistics.
      AIPersonalise - : Boolean which allows the user to choose whether AI recommendations are allowed.
      AIActivityPersonalise - : Boolean which allows the user to choose whether AI recommendations about activities are allowed.
      AICheckinPersonalise - : Boolean which allows the user to choose whether AI recommendations about checkin are allowed.
